rationale: Fresh SELECT_VAL confirmed P3 candidate selector passes research validation (OutputCoverage@20 = 85.0%, PassageHit@1 base reranker = 75.0%), but has insufficient margin for production promotion against the immutable >= 85.0% PassageHit@1 gate, which would require a mathematically perfect downstream reranker on every covered query. To preserve stability for the mentor-facing MVP, Renal V5 is closed as a research milestone, and V3 is preserved as the production default.
